## 1. Context

### Purpose
Claude Code configuration project — public repo mirror of ~/.claude/.
Houses hooks, modules, rules, agents, skills, MCP servers, templates, and tools
that define Claude Code behavior across all sessions and projects.

### Actors
| Actor | Role | Interface |
|-------|------|-----------|
| user | Primary operator / architect | Claude Code CLI |
| Claude Code | AI assistant runtime | ~/.claude/ config |
| Subagents / Skills | Task executors | Task() / TeamCreate |
| MCP servers | Tool providers | stdio / JSON-RPC |
| Git remote | Config sync | git push/pull |

### Scope
- **In scope**: hooks, rules, modules, agents, skills, MCP Go servers, templates, project-init, tools-mcp
- **Out of scope**: working data in /opt/work/osint|pentest|devops|dfir|..., secrets, credentials

## 2. Components / Areas

### Overview
| Component | Purpose | Owner | Status |
|-----------|---------|-------|--------|
| hooks/ | 19 hooks (SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, Stop) | user | active |
| rules/ | 9 auto-loaded behavioral rules | user | active |
| modules/ | 13 active + 13 archived on-demand domain knowledge | user | active |
| agents/ | 102 custom subagent definitions | user | active |
| skills/ | 103 skill wrappers (96 fork + 6 utility + project-init) | user | active |
| mcp-servers/ | 6 Go MCP servers (backlog, doctor, gc, profile, score, tools) | user | active |
| templates/project-init/ | 32 templates: ARCHITECTURE, permissions, FILEMAP, MEMORY, etc. | user | active |
| output-styles/ | 7 Output Style files (system prompt level) | user | active |
| tools/ | 2 CLI utilities + 15 MCP tools via tools-mcp | user | active |
| prompts/ | 7 domain prompts (security, osint, dfir, devops, compliance, reverse, network) | user | active |

### Key Interactions
- SessionStart hook → ensure_essential (loads 13 MCP servers) → AUTO_ACTION detection → project-init skill
- UserPromptSubmit hook → keyword detection → profile-mcp profile rotation
- PreToolUse hook → settings_backup, gitleaks scan, scope_tracking
- Skill invocation: User prompt → keyword match → Skill() → fork → agent execution → result
- MCP profile rotation: profile-mcp → modifies ~/.claude.json → session restart required

## 3. Decisions (ADR Log)

| ID | Date | Decision | Status | Context |
|----|------|----------|--------|---------|
| ADR-001 | 2026-02-26 | Use LOCAL scope for MCP servers (~/.claude.json projects."*") | Accepted | USER scope not loaded in sessions |
| ADR-002 | 2026-03-01 | Migrate Python CLI tools to Go MCP servers | Accepted | Performance, type safety, concurrent safety |
| ADR-003 | 2026-03-01 | Remove plugins/ directory (10 toolkits, 7.2MB) | Accepted | Dead code, maintenance burden |
| ADR-004 | 2026-03-17 | Output Style as PRIMARY behavioral control (7 styles) | Accepted | v9.0 Architecture Redesign Path C |
| ADR-005 | 2026-03-17 | CORE_INSTRUCTIONS.md via --append-system-prompt-file | Accepted | Backup behavioral layer, 27 lines |
| ADR-006 | 2026-03-25 | ARCHITECTURE.md created at check-mode init | Accepted | Missing from earlier project-init |
| ADR-007 | 2026-04-19 | tools-mcp criteria_* keyed by Claude Code PPID, не глобальным current_session_id | Accepted | Параллельные сессии видели чужие frozen criteria из-за shared `~/.claude/evaluation/data/current_session_id`. PPID parent-процесса (Claude Code) уникален per-session, наследуется одинаково tools-mcp child'ом и UserPromptSubmit hook child'ом, общий для main + Task() subagent + TeamCreate teammate в одной сессии. Защита от PID reuse: добавляется `start_epoch` из `/proc/<ppid>/stat` field 22 в имя директории. PoC: `/opt/project/poc/adr-007-ppid-isolation/` |

## 4. Constraints

| Constraint | Type | Impact | Mitigation |
|------------|------|--------|------------|
| Claude Code session isolation | Technical | Env vars not persisted; session_id via file | Use /opt/ file-based state |
| MCP LOCAL scope only | Technical | USER scope not loaded | Always use LOCAL (claude mcp add) |
| settings.local.json can only narrow | Security | Cannot widen global permissions | Project-init enforces this |
| 1.1GB → 561MB size reduction | Technical | Large dead files removed | GC targets + periodic cleanup |
| GC cooldown 1h | Operational | AUTO_ACTION won't re-trigger for 1h | .claude-init-attempted marker |

## 5. Principles

1. **Security by default** — deny > ask > allow hierarchy, no widening of permissions
2. **Fail-open on errors** — always return a result, never hang or silently fail
3. **Read-Once Rule** — never re-read files in subagents; pass content in prompt
4. **Automatic verification** — hooks enforce gitleaks, scope tracking, settings backup
5. **Worse is Better** — simplicity over flexibility; avoid over-engineering

## 9. CI/CD Pipeline

| Stage | Tool | Trigger | Notes |
|-------|------|---------|-------|

| Sync | git push | Manual | user triggers |
| GC | gc-mcp --quick | SessionStart | Lightweight cleanup |
| GC full | gc-mcp --run | Manual / disk >500MB | 16 targets |
